1: I, Baruch, said: O Lord my Lord, have you indeed brought this evil upon your people? Does the ruler judge his servants as a man judges his enemies? For we are all a breath, and our days are a shadow, and you are the one who counts the breaths and the shadows — and will you not be merciful to the shadow, since you yourself made the light that casts it?
[2 Baruch 14:9 — The lamp of the word]

For what is man, that you should be wroth with him, or what is the seed of the earth, that you should reprove it? For we all are a vapour and a breath. But the word of the law is a lamp, and the lamp is not blown out by the breath — and that is the difference between us and our days.
2: And it shall come to pass, when that appointed day arrives, that every one shall be measured according to his deeds, and the measuring shall be merciful to the merciful, and the measuring shall be exact, and both the mercy and the exactness are the justice of the Most High, and both are His love.

And it shall come to pass after these things, when the time of the advent of the Messiah is fulfilled, that He shall return in glory. Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again — and the graves shall open like doors, and the earth shall give back what it borrowed, and the giving back shall be a joy.
3: [2 Baruch 51:3-5 — The glory of the righteous]

And the glory of those who have been righteous shall shine forth, and they shall see the world renewed. For they shall be made like the angels, and be equal to the stars, and they shall be changed into every form they desire — from beauty into loveliness, and from light into the splendour of glory. And the wicked shall see it, and their seeing shall be their sorrow, and their sorrow shall be just.

For if you wish to know, read the book that I have written, and keep the words of it as the apple of your eye. For the days are coming when the books shall be opened, and the scrolls shall speak, and every hidden thing shall be a voice — and your name, if it is written there in faithfulness, will answer when the voice calls it.
